proposal: The chapter recommends repealing the tax increases from the 2022 Inflation Reduction Act (book minimum tax, stock buyback excise tax, coal excise tax, Superfund tax, drug-manufacturer excise tax) and the green-energy credits in its Subtitle D. sources.title: Public Law 119-21 (enrolled text, table of contents)
Congress Phases Out Energy Tax Credits
2025 Tax Legislation Update: Key Provisions and Implications of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act

status_summary: Public Law 119-21 (signed 2025-07-04) made the estate and gift tax exemption permanent at $15 million, indexed, from 2026, and made 100 percent expensing permanent. It ended or phased out many Inflation Reduction Act energy credits: clean vehicle credits ended 2025-09-30, residential energy credits (25C and 25D) ended 2025-12-31, and wind and solar projects keep the production and investment credits only if construction began before 2026-07-04 or they are placed in service by the end of 2027. Other credits (for example 45X, 45Q, 45U, 45Z, and credits for storage, geothermal and fuel cells) continue with new foreign-entity restrictions. The tax on global intangible income (now net CFC tested income) falls to an effective rate of about 12.6 percent, with the foreign tax credit haircut cut from 20 to 10 percent, close to the chapter's 12.5 percent ceiling. On the state and local tax deduction the Act moved opposite to the chapter in the near term, raising the cap to $40,000 for 2025 through 2029 before a permanent $10,000 cap, instead of repealing the deduction. The law's table of contents lists no section repealing the corporate book minimum tax or the stock buyback excise tax, and the summaries reviewed do not mention their repeal.

timeline.event: Public Law 119-21 enacted. The enrolled text includes Section 70106 (estate and gift exemption), Section 70120 (state and local tax limitation) and Sections 70501 to 70513 and following, which terminate or restrict clean vehicle, home energy, clean electricity production and clean electricity investment credits (section titles from the table of contents).

Law-firm summaries report: estate and gift exclusion set permanently at $15 million, indexed, for decedents dying and gifts made after 2025; state and local tax cap raised to $40,000 for 2025 through 2029, then returning to $10,000; effective global intangible low-taxed income rate about 12.6 percent for tax years beginning after 2025.
Under the Act, the clean vehicle credit (30D), previously owned clean vehicle credit (25E) and commercial clean vehicle credit (45W) end for vehicles acquired after this date.
Under the Act, the energy efficient home improvement credit (25C) and residential clean energy credit (25D) end.
Under the Act, wind and solar projects that begin construction on or after this date lose eligibility for the 45Y and 48E credits unless they are placed in service by the end of 2027.

title: Repeal IRA clean-energy credits and make the 2017 estate tax relief permanent
